newsitem.title: UK: UK mortgage lending reaches seven year high - paper.
newsitem.headline: UK mortgage lending reaches seven year high - paper.

text.p: The housing market has received another boost with news from Barclays Bank Plc that mortgage lending has reached its highest level for seven years, The Times newspaper said on Friday.
The Barclays Mortgage index shows the value of gross mortgage advances in December was 24 percent up on the same month in 1995, The Times said.
It said that total gross lending for last year as a whole is expected to reach 71 million pounds ($119.9 million) -- the highest since 1990.
Earlier this week international property consultant Savills Plc forecast resdential property prices could rise by 12 percent this year, compared with 8.5 percent last year. ($1=.5922 Pound)
